read.en: Coherent slipped 1.0% on Nov 12 to $232.08 after a wide $210.08–240.99 range. It is above the rising 5-day ($219.9) and the 10-day ($208.2) and below the 30-day ($247.3), 100-day ($289.2) and 200-day ($296.8); only the 5 and 200-day are rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($166.28), and RSI is 49.2.
read.zh: Coherent 11月12日下跌 1.0%，收于 $232.08，盘中区间较宽，为 $210.08–240.99。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$219.9）和 10 日均线（$208.2）上方，30 日（$247.3）、100 日（$289.2）和 200 日均线（$296.8）下方；仅 5 日和 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看涨（$166.28），RSI 为 49.2。

read.en: The intraday drop to $210.08 briefly lost the $220.7–229.5 support, but the close recovered above it. Resistance is $235.8–241 (Oct 27–29 closes, Nov 12 high), then $245.7–247.3 (Nov 11 and Oct 29 highs, 30-day). Support is $223.5–229.5, then $219.9–220.7 (5-day, Jul 29 low) and $207–210 (10-day, Nov 10 and 12 lows). A close above $241 would target $246–247; below $223.5, $220.

s.en: Nov 11 low $223.52; Nov 10 high $227.77; Nov 9 high $229.48
